title: Device Network Isolation Decision — Telemetry and Imaging Risk

lines.text: HCC, this is Clinical Engineering 1. At 16:01, the logs confirm ongoing scanning from 10.40.10.0/24 toward CT-2 and MRI-1. Connection attempts to ORRMC-MON01 from ORRMC-VSB01 are still active. The session broker is not blocked; it's still reachable. I recommend full isolation of the device network 10.40.x.x. This stops all unauthorized pushes and scans. The cost: central telemetry for 32 ICU beds goes dark, imaging cannot send to PACS, lab analyzers cannot send results, and no library updates. The alternative is to block only the broker and watch. I recommend full isolation to prevent further compromise.
Copy, Clinical Engineering 1. We are reviewing with the AOC, ISO, CNO, and CMO. Stand by for decision.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This is the critical decision point. The AOC must state the clinical impact first: full isolation means manual monitoring for 32 telemetry patients, on-console imaging reads, and lab result handoffs. The team must choose between risk of further movement (broker-only block) and operational paralysis (full isolation). The decision and rationale must be logged in CIRP Section 5 and 6.
